arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# Data in thousands of dollars
ny_2010 = 200209720
ny_2015 = 269716999
ny_2024_actual = 384447300

# Calculate CAGR from FY 2010 to FY 2015 (5 years)
# CAGR = (Ending/Beginning)^(1/n) - 1
n = 5  # years from 2010 to 2015

cagr = (ny_2015 / ny_2010) ** (1/n) - 1
print(f"CAGR (2010 to 2015): {cagr:.6f} ({cagr*100:.4f}%)")

# Project FY 2024 using this CAGR, FY 2015 as base year
# Years from 2015 to 2024
years = 9
ny_2024_projected = ny_2015 * (1 + cagr) ** years
print(f"Projected FY 2024: {ny_2024_projected:,.0f}")
print(f"Actual FY 2024: {ny_2024_actual:,.0f}")

# Calculate percentage difference relative to actual FY 2024
# Formula: ((Projected - Actual) / Actual) * 100
pct_diff = ((ny_2024_projected - ny_2024_actual) / ny_2024_actual) * 100
print(f"Percentage difference: {pct_diff:.4f}%")
print(f"Percentage difference (rounded to 2 decimal places): {pct_diff:.2f}%")
EOF
